title: The Clock
summary: A memory of how time becomes the first rule of the House and gradually moves from the wall into the people themselves.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: A clock quietly becomes an internal authority without ever being named as one.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: When does a schedule stop organizing a person and start living inside them?

links.note: The clock is the first concrete object through which the House's working-time discipline becomes visible.
